purpose: Correctness and snapshot diagnostics, not sustained latency comparison
limitations: Correctness checks and cumulative counters only; no paired latency or FPS comparison.
Duplicate pending-job snapshot skip was tested with unit tests but its counter was not observed in this GUI run.
GUI worker contention and rapid viewport changes while a worker is pending remain unverified.
Final 50% effect screenshot was not returned because the app quit; that screenshot is not used as evidence.

viewport_readiness_followup.implementation: Native readiness additionally matches preparation viewport width, height, scale, zoom, pan and document dimensions. Worker raster keys remain document based.

gui_validation.effects_5000: 200% -> exposure 0.51 (intermediate keyboard input) -> 50% -> exposure 0.5 -> move/undo/redo/undo -> 200% -> restore exposure 1 and save
gui_validation.visual_result: Expected colors, viewport, object positions and selection bounds observed in returned screenshots.
gui_validation.limitations: CUA observations separate actions; overlap with a pending worker was not established. This is not a deterministic worker race or paired latency comparison.
